hypotheses.name: Continuous biological-support interaction for geometric utility
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 with source/target disjoint splits at layers 0/3/7/11, fit baseline vs interaction logistic models using geometry features (euclidean/geodesic/diffusion/detour/convexity) and a leakage-safe continuous support score (DoRothEA + GO + OmniPath fallback), with support permutation nulls stratified by degree x coexpression x geodesic.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.13169 overall; 4/6 domain-split Fisher-significant interaction support; top-vs-bottom support-decile uplift gap positive in 4/6 domain-splits
hypotheses.next_action: Add true STRING edge-score priors and rerun with the same calibration to confirm whether lung catches up to immune/external-lung.

hypotheses.name: Split-zigzag persistence proxy with split-swap and layer-order controls
hypotheses.method: On seed42 across domains/splits/layers {0,3,7,11}, computed split-local neighborhood PH summaries, built edge-local split-zigzag proxy scores, and compared against geodesic baseline with split-swap and layer-order permutation controls (fallback because true zigzag persistence tooling was unavailable).
hypotheses.result_value: +0.01153 overall; 5/6 domain-splits positive directionally, but 0/6 domain-split Fisher-significant under layer-order controls
hypotheses.next_action: Install zigzag-capable TDA tooling and rerun this branch with true split-complex zigzag persistence instead of proxy local PH summaries.

hypotheses.name: Out-of-sample intrinsic-dimension moment validation
hypotheses.method: Using H38 moment features, evaluated leave-one-layer-out and leave-one-seed-out predictions of layerwise local-linearity AUROC and tested out-of-sample delta R2 (full minus mean-only models) against permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: -10.70017 overall; only 4/12 domain-split-evaluation rows with p<0.05, with large instability in several leave-seed-out settings
hypotheses.next_action: Treat H38 mechanism as non-promoted; only revisit with robust OOS metrics that control extreme holdout instability.
